channel.title: Discover Lithuania — A Traveler's Guide
channel.description: 152+ handpicked cafés, restaurants, stays, nature spots and ready-made routes across 12 regions of Lithuania. By Niv Shimoni.

item.title: A Perfect Day in Vilnius
item.dc:creator: Niv Shimoni
item.description: From Baroque alleys to Užupis — a curated one-day itinerary through Vilnius. Brunch at Backstage, Cathedral Square, Gediminas Tower, lunch at 2 virėjai, Užupis art republic, MO Museum, dinner at BARN, and rooftop drinks at 3M žOS.
item.content:encoded:
A curated one-day route through Vilnius, Lithuania's capital. Cobbled lanes, world-class coffee, and the breakaway art republic of Užupis — all in one day.

  • 09:00 — Brunch at Backstage Roastery Café
  • 11:00 — Cathedral Square
  • 12:00 — Climb Gediminas Tower
  • 13:30 — Lunch at 2 virėjai (honest Lithuanian food)
  • 15:00 — Užupis art republic
  • 17:00 — MO Museum (modern Lithuanian art)
  • 19:30 — Dinner at BARN Bistro
  • 22:00 — Rooftop drink at 3M žOS

View full itinerary →

item.title: Vilnius & The Region — Weekend Itinerary
item.dc:creator: Niv Shimoni
item.description: A day in the city, a day in nature. Vilnius MO Museum and Užupis on Day 1 — then Trakai by way of Snapas café, the island castle, and a hot air balloon over the lakes on Day 2.
item.content:encoded:
Two days that cover both sides of Lithuania: the urban energy of Vilnius and the lakeside magic of Trakai.

  • Day 1 — Vilnius: MO Museum & Užupis street art walk
  • Day 2 morning — Trakai: coffee & pastry at Snapas café
  • Day 2 afternoon — Trakai Castle + lunch at Kiubėtė on the lake
  • Day 2 late — Hot air balloon over the castle & lakes

View full itinerary →

item.title: A Weekend in the Forests
item.dc:creator: Niv Shimoni
item.description: Lakes, forest cabins, and a traditional Lithuanian sauna (pirtis). A digital detox weekend in the Lithuanian countryside — Varėna treehouse and a villa on the lake.

item.title: Three Days on the Coast — Klaipėda, Nida & the Curonian Spit
item.dc:creator: Niv Shimoni
item.description: Port city, UNESCO dunes, and a luxury spa. Three days along the Lithuanian coast — Klaipėda old town, the Great Dune at Nida, and Stebuklai SPA in the pine forest.

item.title: Druskininkai Spa Weekend
item.dc:creator: Niv Shimoni
item.description: Mineral springs, float therapy, Dead Sea salt rooms, and pine forests. A full spa weekend in Druskininkai — Lithuania's premier wellness destination.

item.title: Explore Vilnius — Baroque Capital of the Baltics
item.dc:creator: Niv Shimoni
item.description: Cobbled lanes, terracotta roofs, and a café on every corner. The Užupis art republic just across the river. 40+ handpicked places in Vilnius — from the best espresso bars to hidden courtyards.

item.title: Explore Trakai — Castle on the Lake
item.dc:creator: Niv Shimoni
item.description: Lithuania's only island castle, rising from Lake Galvė. Karaim heritage, colorful boats, fresh kibinai straight from the oven, and a hot air balloon ride over the lakes.

item.title: Explore the Curonian Spit (Nida) — UNESCO Dunes & Pine Forests
item.dc:creator: Niv Shimoni
item.description: Giant dunes down a narrow peninsula, pine forests, and pastel fishing villages. The Curonian Spit is a UNESCO World Heritage Site shared between Lithuania and Russia's Kaliningrad.
